technical-summary: Removed 42 stale checked-in llama.cpp llama-server Windows binaries (~46MB) from src/audiagentic/runtime/rig/embedded/bin/. Confirmed via resolution.py that runtime resolution never reads from this src-tree path (only global harness dir or project .audiagentic/provisioning/rig/embedded/bin), pyproject.toml only declares models.json as package data (not bin/), and LlamaCppRecipe/binaries.py install to the resolved runtime_bin_dir(), never to this location.
user-summary-candidate: Removed unused, unreferenced llama.cpp binaries from the source tree; rig binaries are provisioned at runtime via the LlamaCppRecipe, not checked into git.

technical-summary: Deleted the agent_execution_submit MCP tool (direct execution_profile_id submission, bypassing Agent Definition resolution). agent_task_submit is now the sole submission surface on ag-agents-gateway. Audited callers first via repo-wide grep: only the tool's own definition/config/tests/docs referenced it, no ACP/A2A/CLI/agent_jobs caller existed. Direct execution_profile_id submission stays available programmatically (AgentTaskFactory.submit_raw/submit_execution_request), just not over MCP. Verified set(agents.yaml direct-tools) == set(tool-descriptions keys) == set(@mcp.tool() registered names) for the 8 remaining tools.
user-summary-candidate: Removed the deprecated agent_execution_submit MCP tool; agent_task_submit (agent-definition-based) is now the only way to submit agent work over MCP.

technical-summary: Performed AS64's prescribed inventory (grep for capability usage in providers/services/session, and the Role required_capabilities vocabulary from AS61) before building an admission-time capability-check layer. Found required_capabilities is defined on the Role model but read by zero code paths, the one real Role in this repo's config has it empty, and the one real Execution Profile has no model-facts fields to check. No demonstrated need exists. Closed the item as not-needed per its own reassess-or-close doctrine rather than building speculative machinery.
user-summary-candidate: Investigated whether agent capability checks (AS64) are needed yet; found no real Role or Execution Profile currently requires one, so closed the item without building unused infrastructure.

technical-summary: Added the agents/role-precedence contribution documenting Role vs Execution Profile vs workflow-profile vs component-profile resolution precedence and the fail-closed conflict rule, closing AS61's last open RO01-absorbed gap. Honest about current state: no standalone agent-role-id job field exists yet (that's AS78), so this fixes the rule ahead of the field rather than leaving it to be improvised later.
user-summary-candidate: Documented how Role selection will interact with Execution Profile/workflow-profile/component-profile precedence once a standalone role-selection field exists.

technical-summary: Added get_provider_mcp_launch_isolation_tier(provider_id), a narrow public read API mirroring the existing get_provider_execution_isolation_tier exactly. Closes a gap found while inventorying evidence for AS77 (Role capability resolver): the mcp_launch_isolation_tier descriptor field had an internal consumer (prepare_provider_mcp_surface) but no narrow public read seam. Only pi and opencode currently declare exact MCP launch isolation.
user-summary-candidate: Added a public API to query whether a provider supports exact MCP launch isolation (currently pi and opencode only), first increment toward the Role capability resolver.
